description:
W.E.B. Du Bois confronts the harsh realities of race in America with piercing clarity in *Darkwater: Voices From Within the Veil*. Through a series of evocative poems and essays, he boldly examines the struggles faced by African Americans in the shadow of Jim Crow laws and societal prejudice. Each piece acts as a powerful testament to the resilience of a community navigating the complexities of identity, oppression, and hope.

At the heart of *Darkwater* is Du Bois's exploration of the duality of existence for black Americans—living between the worlds of oppression and aspiration. He dives into the emotional turmoil of this experience, revealing personal stories that resonate with universal themes of injustice and yearning for dignity. As listeners journey through his poignant reflections, they will encounter the profound impact of systemic racism and the relentless pursuit of freedom and equality.

Du Bois's voice resonates across generations, provoking thought and inspiring action. His words challenge listeners to reflect on their own understanding of race and humanity. What does it mean to live within the veil? How does one find light in darkness?

*Darkwater* is not just a collection of verses; it is a call to awareness and empathy, inviting listeners to engage with the complexities of the human experience. Discover the power of Du Bois's legacy and the enduring relevance of his message in today’s world.

title: AI for Every Business
author: Daniel Perorne
description:
For the last three years, the story of AI has been written by the largest companies in the world. They have the data teams, the integration budgets and the patience to run a pilot for eighteen months. The thirty-three million businesses that employ most of the country got something else: a chat window, a monthly subscription, and a vague instruction to figure it out.

AI for Every Business is about moving that curve. It is a weekly show for the owners and operators of small and mid-size companies, the people who run restaurants, trades, brokerages, distributors and professional firms, and who have been told AI would change their business without ever seeing it change a Monday morning.

Every episode starts with a real business and a real problem. The invoices nobody chases. The schedule built by hand every Sunday night. The lead that goes cold between the website and a callback. The process that lives in one employee's head. We follow each one through the four things AI has to do to earn its keep: collect the data from the systems the business already runs, understand it, orchestrate the work across people and software, and produce an outcome the owner can put a number on. Hours back. Dollars saved. Errors that stopped happening.

Some weeks the show is a conversation: owners on what they tried, what failed, what finally worked, and what they would tell a peer. Some weeks it is live. An owner brings a pain point, the clock starts, and the problem is solved on air in thirty minutes, with the cost to run it shown on screen before the episode ends.

The show is produced by the team behind LIBBi, the orchestration platform built on a simple idea: that every business, not just the enterprise, should be able to describe a problem in plain language and have it solved, with building free and the price set by what the work costs to run. LIBBi comes up when it is the answer. The business is always the subject.

AI was supposed to be for everyone. This is the show that holds it to that.

Pitch Studio is a new Rwandan television and radio show created through a partnership between Arthur Nation and the Rwanda Broadcasting Agency (RBA), with support from the Ministry of Youth and Arts.

Hosted by Arthur Nkusi, the show aims to inspire the Rwandan community to identify problems, think creatively, and turn business ideas into action. It provides a platform for two groups of entrepreneurs:

Dreamers – People with promising business ideas who need funding and support. They pitch their ideas to the public and receive votes for a chance to secure funding to bring their ideas to life.

Founders – Entrepreneurs with existing businesses who are seeking angel investment to grow their ventures, expand their impact, and take their businesses to the next level.


By showcasing the ideas, journeys, and ambitions of Dreamers and Founders, Pitch Studio encourages viewers to recognise the potential in their own ideas, take initiative, and pursue entrepreneurship to solve problems, create opportunities, and contribute to Rwanda’s development.

The show will air across RBA’s television and radio network, including RTV, Radio Rwanda, Magic FM, KC2, and community radio stations, reaching audiences across the country and bringing inspiring entrepreneurial stories closer to the Rwandan community.


At its heart, Pitch Studio is guided by three core values: Inspire, Fund, and Educate. Through these values, the show seeks to inspire people to believe in their ideas, connect promising ventures with funding opportunities, and educate the public through real stories of entrepreneurship, innovation, and business growth.

The shows are polished up a bit for you to enjoy the replays on your favorite Podcast platforms!

description:
Two sweethearts with a love for all things spooky. 
We’re diving into chilling true stories, haunted places, creepy history, and the legends that still keep people up at night. Come get scared with us because everything’s a little less terrifying when you’ve got your person beside you.

title: Silk Road International Podcast
author: David Dayton
description: Conversations about corporate cultures and doing business in China and Southeast Asia.

title: Rhapsody Reflections
author: Oakridge Studios
description:
Rhapsody Reflections is a devotional podcast inspired by Rhapsody of Realities, the daily devotional by Pastor Chris Oyakhilome, read by millions of people around the world in thousands of languages.

Each episode takes you through a topic in a few focused minutes:

📖 The Theme Scripture: the verse that sets the tone for the topic
💬 The Message: a life-changing truth from God's Word, applied to everyday living
🙏 Prayer & Confession: declare God's Word over your life
📚 Further Study: scriptures to dig deeper

Whether you listen on your morning commute, during your quiet time or before you sleep, these reflections will build your faith, renew your mind and help you live with purpose.

🎧 Subscribe, turn on notifications, and share with someone who needs a word.

Messages are inspired by Rhapsody of Realities. This podcast is an independent listener production and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rhapsody of Realities or LoveWorld.

Get your copy of Rhapsody of Realities at rhapsodyofrealities.org.

Scripture quotations from the King James Version (Public Domain).

title: The Quiet Edit
author: Lauren L'Heureux
description:
The Quiet Edit is a conversation about building an exceptional life in an age of constant visibility.
In a culture that rewards being seen, we explore a different way of building—one rooted in intention, discernment, and quiet ambition.
Through strategic perspectives and intimate conversations with accomplished founders, creatives, and executives, we explore the decisions, philosophies, and defining moments that shape extraordinary businesses, remarkable careers, and enduring legacies. Not the highlight reel—but the thinking behind it.
This is where we talk about legacy instead of algorithms, depth instead of scale, and substance instead of spectacle.
Because we believe in individual affluence over global influence.

title: Phantom Footnotes
author: Jason Rose
description:
Welcome to Phantom Footnotes, the spooky history and folklore podcast where we find meaning in the margins of the stories we share.
Join host, Jason Rose, as they uncover the true history behind some of our favorite legends of haunted locations, cursed objects, cryptid encounters, and all things spooky. 
Schedule:
New Podcast Seasons starting every October and April!
In the off season expect casual scary story readings and listener encounters.
All episodes will be biweekly
Subscribe to never miss a new spooky episode!

title: Background Reading (Kaha Mind)
author: Kaha Mind
description: We’ve been asking a lot of questions lately. Not just about what psychology tells us, but about what happens when you look a little closer at the research behind it. That’s the thinking behind Background Reading, a new podcast from Kaha Mind. Each episode starts in behavioural research and from there we follow the evidence, pull apart what we think we know, and see where it takes us. We’re excited to finally put it out into the world. Follow Background Reading for the episodes to come.

title: Easy English With Dec
author: Dec
description:
Learn English with short, relaxed episodes about everyday life. Join Dec for slow, clear English, useful words and simple phrases.
Easy English with Dec is for beginners and anyone who enjoys listening at a slower pace. Listen wherever you are, and speak along if you like!

title: Chick Flicks For Dicks
author: Ross and Nick
description: Impress your girlfriend or partner with your knowledge of chick flicks…without having to watch them. We’ll tell you all you need to know…and maybe a little bit more!

title: Tall Tails: Animal Legends and Real Science for Kids
author: Four Fireflies Audio
description: Why does the tortoise have a cracked shell? Why does the bear have a short tail? On Tall Tails, storyteller Wren shares animal origin legends from cultures around the world, and his friend Dr. Moss, a very excited biologist with a magnifying glass named Gerald, keeps jumping in with the real science. Two stories, one big question, and a whole lot of interrupting. For curious kids ages 5 to 12 and the grown-ups who listen along. Tall Tails is made by a family using AI voices and AI writing tools, and every episode is fact-checked.

title: Deep Mission Fishing Podcast with Scotty Thorrington
author: Deep Mission
description:
Pull up a chair and crack a cold one. The Deep Mission Fishing Podcast is hosted by Captain Scott "Scotty" Thorrington of Haven Sportfishing Charters. Scotty has spent more than 40 years chasing marlin, kingfish and snapper off the NSW Central Coast, and in each episode he sits down with old mates from the fishing world.
These are relaxed, honest conversations between people who've shared decks, tournaments and plenty of early mornings. You'll hear the stories that only come out between friends: the fish of a lifetime, the ones that got away, the characters, the close calls, and the lessons learned the hard way. There's also plenty of real-world know-how along the way, from bait and tackle to reading the conditions and finding fish.
Whether you're a seasoned game fisher or just love a good yarn about life on the water, come along for the ride. It's all about the fishing and the friendships.

title: Environment Variables
author: Green Software Foundation
description:
Each episode we discuss the latest news regarding how to reduce the emissions of software and how the industry is dealing with its own environmental impact. Brought to you by The Green Software Foundation.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: NWA Table Talk
author: Marcus Bell
description: Conversations about local food, gatherings and events across Northwest Arkansas, from Bentonville and Rogers to Springdale and Fayetteville. Hosted by Marcus Bell.

title: MYSTERIOUS CRIMES AND HORRORS
author: MYSTERIOUS CRIMES AND HORRORS
description: MYSTERIOUS CRIMES AND HORRORS 🔎🌑 Step into the dark world of unsolved mysteries, chilling crimes, unexplained phenomena, and terrifying real-life stories. Mysterious Crimes and Horrors takes you deep into the shadows of the unknown, uncovering shocking cases, puzzling disappearances, haunting encounters, and disturbing events that continue to leave the world searching for answers. From baffling cold cases and criminal investigations to paranormal mysteries and spine-chilling horror stories, every episode explores the details, theories, and hidden clues behind the stories that capture our darkest curiosities. Prepare to question what you know, explore the unexplained, and discover the secrets hidden beneath the surface of seemingly ordinary events. 🎙️ If you love true crime, unsolved mysteries, psychological thrillers, and supernatural horror, this is the podcast for you. Mysterious Crimes and Horrors — Where every mystery has a story, every shadow hides a secret, and some questions have no easy answers. ⚠️ Listener discretion is advised. Some episodes may contain disturbing themes and descriptions of criminal activity.

title: SkyJar
author: Skyler Garris, Jared Corya, Toby Taskey
description:
Tier lists, challenges, cooking, goofy ideas. And most importantly, a good time with friends :)
Welcome to SkyJar.

title: Self Aware & Still Spiraling
author: Calley Merkel
description:
Ever driven five miles past your exit and realized your brain was playing a high-definition highlight reel of an awkward conversation from ten years ago? Or put your phone in the pantry next to the salsa while holding a tub of sour cream?
Welcome to Self Aware and Still Spiraling—the weekly support group for hyperactive, distracted brains trying to do the inner work without taking themselves too seriously. Knowing why you spiral doesn't magically stop the spiral overnight.
Hosted with maximum sarcasm and zero guru energy, this show breaks down anxiety, burnout, boundary-setting, and overthinking into bite-sized, practical resets.

What to expect:
Real Talk: Honest takes on anxiety, dissociation, childhood baggage, and people-pleasing.
Micro-Practices: Quick grounding tricks and physical resets for people who hate traditional meditation.
Zero Judgment: Space to laugh at the absurd reality of being a chaotic human being.

What you won't find here:
❌ 4:30 AM ice baths
❌ $300 crystal-infused water bottles
❌ Lectures from someone claiming to have reached total, uninterrupted inner peace


Unclench your jaw, drop those shoulders down from your ears, and hit Follow to listen every week. Let's figure this out together—one slightly less panicked step at a time.

title: Team Talk Israel
author: The London Initiative
description: Team Talk Israel is the podcast of The London Initiative (TLI). Join communications consultant, David Krikler, in conversation with TLI members and other prominent figures from Israel, the Jewish world and international allies to explore how we can build more effective partnerships to promote liberal democracy, societal fairness, and secure peace.

title: The Hill Country Podcast
author: Tom Fox
description: The Texas Hill Country is one of the most beautiful places on earth. In this award-winning podcast, Hill Country resident Tom Fox visits with the people and organizations that make this the most unique areas of Texas. Join Tom as he explores the people, places and their activities of the Texas Hill Country.

title: The Breastfeeding Show
author: Frances Attenborough, Karen Hall and Megan Stephenson
description:
The Breastfeeding Show is made by Frances Attenborough, Karen Hall and Megan Stephenson, who are all NCT-trained Breastfeeding Counsellors, with at least ten years’ each of experience helping parents both through antenatal sessions, and group and 1:1 postnatal support. This show is for anyone with an interest in feeding babies, whether they’re exclusively breastfeeding, chestfeeding, mixed feeding, expressing, still waiting for their baby to arrive, or thinking about stopping.


In our first series, we cover the basics of how to get started, establishing a milk supply, positioning and attachment, expressing, common challenges, and we bust a few myths. We hope our informal style keeps things interesting and useful, as we chat about our absolute favourite subject.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Eduan Bekker
author: Eduan Bekker
description: Eduan Bekker is a software engineer and technology consultant with a strong focus on software architecture, scalable systems, and complex technical problem-solving. He works across freelance and consulting projects, helping businesses design and implement reliable solutions from concept through completion. Eduan prefers building systems that are stable, maintainable, and designed for long-term use rather than relying on temporary fixes. Beyond software engineering, he runs a metal fabrication venture and has a strong interest in 3D printing and cars. His practical mindset extends across both digital and physical projects, allowing him to approach challenges creatively while remaining focused on building solutions that work.

title: Arm Yourself
author: Laura Day
description:
ARM YOURSELF — Equip your spirit with the Word of God. 
A faith‑based podcast exploring spiritual strength, daily encouragement, and the armor of God from Ephesians 6:10.

title: Cinematalk

description: Cinematalk is the perfect podcast to keep you up to date on the current state of Hollywood. Join hosts Ethan Schaps and Lola Melian Lafinur as they break down the latest movie news, discuss film & TV, and do in-depth analysis of various movies and TV series. Tune into new episodes Thursdays @4pm weekly live on KMIH 88.9 The Bridge or listen on all major streaming platforms.

title: Talking With T-Bird
author: Rob Cesternino, Teresa "T-Bird" Cooper
description: On RHAP's "Talking with T-Bird," Rob Cesternino (Survivor: Amazon and Survivor: All-Stars) and co-host Teresa "T-Bird" Cooper (Survivor: Gabon) sit down with iconic Survivor players from seasons past. They look back on the games these players are remembered for and find out what life looks like for them now.

title: The Chico Muya Podcast
author: Chico Muya
description:
Politics, history, culture, and the ideas shaping the future of the West.
Writer and publisher Chico Muya explores the events, ideas, and historical forces shaping our world through independent analysis and long-form commentary.
Read the essays and subscribe to the publication at chicomuya.com.

title: I Am Rich
author: Louise - Crystalline Clarity
description:
I'm rich, not because everything has worked out perfectly or because of what's in the bank, but because of how much life I have available to me.
This is a living room for real-life dilemmas: the contradictions, the stuck places, the lives that don't fit anymore. It's for anyone who senses there's more life available to them and is ready to turn towards it with curiosity, not away.
What if wanting more isn't selfish, but a sign you've outgrown something? What if your triggers are a gift you haven't seen yet?
I'm not here to tell you what to do. Come explore and claim more life with me.

title: Bird Talk: Atlanta Falcons Podcast
author: Bird Talk
description:
Welcome to Bird Talk, the podcast for Atlanta Falcons fans who want real football talk, honest opinions, game breakdowns, and plenty of Falcons passion.
Hosted by Big U and Nick The Host, Bird Talk covers everything happening in the world of Atlanta Falcons football. From game-day reactions and postgame analysis to upcoming matchup previews, player performances, coaching decisions, roster moves, and the latest Falcons news, Big U and Nick The Host bring their unique perspectives to every episode.
Whether you're a lifelong Dirty Bird, a new Falcons fan, or an NFL fan looking for entertaining

title: 713-JUSTICE: Houston Personal Injury Insights
author: Molina Law Firm
description:
Injured in Houston? Demand 713-JUSTICE. Join Attorney Rick Molina from the Molina Law Firm for the 713-JUSTICE Podcast, your go-to resource for navigating the legal aftermath of an accident in Texas. As a former Assistant District Attorney and veteran trial lawyer, Rick Molina brings ”Off the Record” insights into how the insurance companies operate and how you can protect your rights.
Whether you’ve been involved in a Houston car accident, a catastrophic truck wreck, or a workplace injury, we provide the clarity you need. We cover:
Immediate steps to take after a motorcycle or rideshare (Uber/Lyft) crash.
How to maximize the value of your personal injury claim.
Proving negligence in slip and fall or wrongful death cases.
The truth about insurance adjusters and ”quick settlements.”
In Houston, results and experience matter. Don’t settle for less—get the justice you deserve.
Listen, subscribe, and demand 713-JUSTICE. Visit us at www.713justice.com or call 713-587-8423 for a free consultation.

title: Not On My Shift Podcast
author: The Science Bae
description: Healthcare has a lot to say, and so do we! 🎙️ Welcome to Not on My Shift, hosted by The Science Bae, where healthcare meets real talk, career moves, and conversations that need to be had. From travel contracts and credential stacking to industry secrets, workplace drama, and money moves, we're uncovering opportunities, challenging the norms, and discussing what really happens behind the scrubs. Unfiltered conversations. Real experiences. Career-changing information. Because some things just aren't happening on our shift. It's time to clock in!

title: Running The Race in The Marketplace
author: Melina Kazadi
description: Running the Race in the Marketplace is a podcast exploring how faith and Christian identity are lived out in professional settings. It equips believers to navigate workplace culture without compromising their faith, featuring interviews with professionals (lawyers, doctors, teachers, and more) who share real examples of integrity, purpose, and obedience at work.

title: Trash Taste — A Weekly LitRPG Audiobook
author: Godwit
description:
An invitation to preview a new game sends Connor, Joey, Garnt and Chris into a world where character classes aren’t optional and getting home is far from guaranteed.
Trash Taste is a serialised LitRPG adventure with strange creatures, questionable decisions and friends who keep arguing even when their lives depend on it.
Written by Godwit. Narrated by Brad Grochowski.
New chapters released weekly. Start with Chapter 1.
Unofficial fan fiction inspired by the Trash Taste personalities. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Trash Taste podcast.

author: ColonialPestControl
description: Colonial is one of the largest and most sought-after pest control companies in central and eastern Massachusetts and southern New Hampshire.

title: Antifragile You
author: Antifragile You
description:
AntiFragile You is about people who are building lives that strengthen under pressure.
The show looks past the public result and into the private cost: the failure, burnout, risk, craft, health, identity shifts, and reinvention that shaped them.
Beyond generic inspiration. Pressure-tested stories from people who learned the hard way that mistakes are meant to be celebrated.

title: Kessler's Wild West Stories: tales of romance and the frontier
author: Kessler's Wild West Stories
description: I love writing and sharing tales of romance and the frontier!

title: Impact Stream by FEBCanada
author: ImpactFEBC
description: Stories, reflections, and practical guidance for Christians exploring how faith, work, and life intersect missionally — discovering how faith and impact intersect and how everyday choices can impact God’s Kingdom.

title: Brigitte Dale's "Should We Be Concerned?"
author: Brigitte Dale
description: Writer Brigitte Dale discusses the news topics that sound like they could end humanity and decides - should we be concerned? Let's talk about weird space news, AI takeovers, quantum physics concerns, pollinator extinction, plagues and pandemics, science overlapping with the paranormal, and similar cheerful topics.

title: Mind the Skills Gap Apprenticeship Podcast
author: Mind the Skills Gap Apprenticeship Podcast
description:
Mind the Skills Gap: Apprenticeship Podcast explores how apprenticeships are shaping the future of work and helping to bridge the skills gap across today’s workforce. Launched to mark the University of Salford’s 10-year anniversary of delivering apprenticeships in 2026, this podcast brings Salford’s apprenticeship community to life through real voices, real experiences, and real impact.

Each episode features inspiring stories from apprentices, employers, and University of Salford staff, alongside practical advice for businesses, aspiring and current apprentices, and colleagues working across skills and workforce development. We also unpack the latest industry updates, tackle common myths, and explore the facts behind apprenticeship programmes - so you can make informed, confident choices.

Whether you’re an employer looking to develop talent, an individual exploring new career pathways, or a colleague keen to stay informed, Mind the Skills Gap is your go-to source for insight, inspiration, and actionable knowledge. Closely aligned with industry and known for outstanding student satisfaction and award-winning programmes, the University of Salford offers a diverse range of apprenticeships and strong employer partnerships - making it the ideal place to start or progress your apprenticeship journey.

title: CALLED TO BE SEEN
author: Jordan Lynae
description:
Called To Be Seen is the podcast for women who know they’re meant for more — and are ready to stop hiding, reclaim their voice, and become known for who they truly are.
Hosted by author, speaker, and entrepreneur Jordan Lynae, each episode brings honest conversations, transformational stories, and powerful interviews around identity, visibility, purpose, leadership, business, and becoming the woman you were created to be.
Whether you’re building a brand, writing a book, stepping onto stages, navigating a new season, or answering a calling you can no longer ignore, this show will help you trust yourself, use your voice, and move forward with greater clarity and courage.
Because being seen isn’t about becoming louder.
It’s about becoming truer.
You were never meant to stay hidden.

title: The Facial Plastic Surgery Podcast
author: Dr David Sparks & Dr Phaethon Karagiannis
description:
Welcome to The Facial Plastic Surgery Podcast, an educational show providing clear, anatomy-based insights into facial aesthetic procedures.
Hosted by Australian specialist plastic surgeons Dr. David Sparks MBBS, Hons, PhD FRACS (Plast) & Dr Phaethon Karagiannis MBBS, BMedSci, PGDipSurgAnat, MPH, FRACS (Plast) the podcast breaks down complex surgical techniques into honest, easy-to-understand conversations. Drawing on their extensive Australian fellowship training and international post-fellowship experience, Dr. Sparks and Dr. Karagiannis explain the science and reality behind facial surgery. 
Whether you are considering facial surgery or simply curious about the anatomy, this podcast delivers straightforward expert guidance to help you understand your options.
This podcast is for general medical education and informational purposes only and does not constitute individual medical advice. Always consult a qualified specialist surgeon for personalised consultations.

title: Building with Trust
author: Arent van Wassenaer
description:
Building with Trust is the international sister podcast of Bouwen met Vertrouwen, produced by Vereniging Presolve, the Dutch expertise centre for dispute-free construction.
Hosted by Arent van Wassenaer, the series explores how trust, collaboration and dispute prevention can improve construction projects around the world. Through conversations with leading practitioners, lawyers and experts, it examines what makes projects succeed — and how disputes can be prevented before they arise.

title: Best Years Ahead
author: Mike Crane
description:
Welcome to Best Years Ahead, the audio guide for designing a vibrant second adulthood. We leave traditional financial-only retirement planning entirely behind to focus strictly on the human side of transition—identity, active purpose, and personal reinvention—ensuring your next chapter is fully Best Years Ahead compliant. If you are looking past the spreadsheets and wondering what comes next, you are in the right place.
Start mapping your journey: www.bestyearsahead.com

title: Confidence, Built
author: Jordan Blake
description:
Confidence isn't something you have to feel before you begin. It's something you build through action.
In Confidence Built, author Jordan Blake explores the psychology of self-doubt, fear, perfectionism, self-trust and personal growth. Through thoughtful insights, everyday examples and practical exercises, each episode helps you move beyond hesitation, make better decisions and develop confidence grounded in real experience.
No motivational hype. No unrealistic promises. Just a practical approach to becoming someone you can trust.

title: Jamaica Homes Podcast
author: Jamaica Homes
description: Where Property Meets Perspective. A lively deep-dive turning Jamaica Homes news into engaging audio.

title: Unsee Podcast
author: Leonard Pastrana, PharmD
description:
Some moments change how you see medicine forever. Once you see them, you can't unsee them.

Hosted by pharmacist Leonard Pastrana, PharmD, this podcast goes inside the private conversations happening at the leading edge of clinical longevity medicine. It features physicians, scientists, and founders who are seeing things in their patients that the textbooks haven't caught up to yet.

Too often, "show me the data" is where the conversation ends. Here, it's where it begins. Each episode explores the gap between what we know for sure, what doctors see in practice every day, and the uncertainty in between. You'll hear how the best clinicians think, question, and make reasonable decisions when definitive proof doesn't exist yet.

Longevity medicine isn't a new set of rules. It's the evolution of medicine: improving how well you live and how long you live, at the same time.

If you've ever felt like there has to be a better way, these are the conversations for you.

For educational purposes only. Not medical advice.

title: The SoulFull Podcast
author: Nour
description:
Honest conversations about healing, self-worth & faith. 
Gentle reminders for the heart 🤎
Come as you are. Leave SoulFull. 
✨

title: RideShare Mike
author: Human Stories Network
description:
Every passenger has a story. Mike just happens to hear the ones you won't forget.
Inspired by real experiences, RideShare Mike brings hilarious, heartbreaking, and unbelievable stories to life through one unforgettable driver.
Real stories. Reimagined rides.  One unforgettable driver.
Stories are adapted and dramatized for entertainment.
RideShare Mike is a fictional character performed using an AI-generated voice.

title: Thoughts on Education with Curt
author: Curt Beaudin
description: **Thoughts on Education with Curt** is a casual podcast about teaching, language, learning, and the questions that come to mind along the way. Each episode is an informal reflection on ideas, experiences, and issues in education—sometimes from the classroom, sometimes from research, and sometimes just from things I find myself thinking about.

title: The Vampyre - A Tale of Romantic Horror
author: John William Polidori
description:
When Lord Ruthven arrives in London, whispers of his dark charm and sinister reputation send shivers through society's elite. This is no ordinary nobleman; he possesses a magnetic allure that draws both men and women into his orbit, yet a chilling secret lingers beneath his polished exterior. As the tale unfolds, young Aubrey, captivated by Ruthven's enigmatic presence, embarks on a journey that reveals the true nature of friendship, betrayal, and the supernatural.

In this groundbreaking work, John William Polidori crafts a chilling narrative that explores the thin line between desire and danger. As Aubrey becomes entangled in Ruthven's web, he grapples with his own morals and the haunting question: can one resist the pull of darkness? With themes of obsession, the consequences of unchecked passion, and the eerie dance between life and death, "The Vampyre" invites listeners into a world where desire can lead to destruction.

Polidori's vivid prose and rich characterization breathe life into this classic tale, making it a must-listen for horror aficionados and newcomers alike. Unravel the mysteries of Lord Ruthven and discover the chilling truth that lies in the shadows. What happens when the allure of immortality clashes with the fragility of human life? Dive into this haunting narrative and find out—if you dare.

We’ll introduce you to outstanding current and former students, hear from business and community partners, examine the latest workforce trends, take a closer look at career-technical education and, of course, talk about all things Polaris! You can find our podcasts on your favorite platforms - be sure to follow us on social media to stay connected. All episodes are edited and produced by our Broadcasting & Video Production program. Enjoy!

title: Off The Beaten Potcast
author: Off The Beaten Pot
description:
Off The Beaten Pot is a podcast about cooking outdoors, finding adventure in the everyday, and getting back to the things that matter.
From campfire cooking and field kitchen skills to the kit we carry, the people we meet and the places that stay with us, this is a show for those who feel most at home a little further from the beaten track.
Expect practical knowledge, honest conversations, tales from the trail, gear worth talking about, and the occasional bit of chaos along the way. Sometimes it’s about what’s cooking. Sometimes it’s about why we head out there in the first place.

title: The Lane Knew Who Was Missing
author: The Parish Teller
description: An old man remembers village life in Great Barrington, Little Barrington, Windrush and Sherborne. The hub, the lanes, the field, the pig, the fete, the bonfire, the yard, and what the parish became on a Monday.

title: Fertility Unfiltered
author: Neema Savvides
description: A raw and honest take on fertility topics, addressing what others don’t.

title: UK Law Made Simple
author: Ella Woodhouse
description:
Ever wondered what the law actually says about the situations we encounter every day?

UK Law Made Simple takes confusing legal topics and explains them in plain English — without the jargon, complicated legal language, or law degree required.

From self-defence and your rights when dealing with the police, to consumer rights, motoring law, employment, housing, scams, privacy and those strange legal questions you've always wondered about, each episode tackles a different part of UK law and makes it easier to understand.

⚖️ What are your rights?
🏠 What can you legally do in your own home?
🚗 What does the law say when you're behind the wheel?
👮 What powers do the police actually have?
🛒 What happens when a retailer refuses a refund?
🤔 And are those things everyone says are “illegal” actually illegal at all?

New episodes explore the laws that affect ordinary life, using straightforward explanations and real-world examples.

Some laws differ between England and Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland. Where relevant, episodes will make clear which jurisdiction is being discussed.

UK Law Made Simple — because understanding your rights shouldn't require a law degree.

This podcast provides general educational information and does not constitute legal advice.

title: Please Leave a Review
author: Benny Frawntauq
description:
What if you’re not the problem? What if the problem is that consumer standards these days have just gone to the absolute dogs? What if everyone is out to get you? What if a biker gang invites you to swim with dolphins in Baku? What then? 
Introducing Please Leave a Review.

title: The Remedial Scholar: History Revisited
author: Levi Harrison
description: History class lied to you. Not maliciously, but the version of the past handed down through textbooks and school curricula was curated, politically convenient, and almost entirely narrated by whoever came out on top. The Remedial Scholar: History Revisited exists to fix that.  Each episode, host Levi takes a deep dive into the stories that didn't make the highlight reel, or the ones that did but deserve a second look. Topics span ancient history through the modern era: colonial violence, financial crimes, unsolved murders, doomed expeditions, industrial disasters, forgotten rebellions, and the quiet machinery of institutions that shaped the world without ever making the front page. The format is conversational and thoroughly researched, with a healthy skepticism toward received wisdom and the occasional guest whose expertise gets woven into the narrative rather than bolted on. Think: what if your history professor was actually interesting, and also suspicious of everything they were taught. Past episodes have covered: the Salem Witch Trials and the hysteria that made them possible, the Donner Party and what survival actually costs, the Harlem Hellfighters and the racism that followed them home from a war they won, the Coal Wars of West Virginia, Jack the Ripper reconsidered, the Alamo from the Mexican perspective, and whether King George III was ever actually the tyrant we were told he was.  New episodes drop regularly. Keep questioning the past, the future will thank you.

title: The City at World's End (A Nuclear Reckoning)

When a sudden nuclear war erupts, humanity faces a crisis unlike any before. In Edmond Hamilton's gripping sci-fi classic, The City at World's End, a group of survivors discovers that the true threat lies not just in the devastation wrought by bombs, but in the unforeseen consequences that follow. As they navigate the ruins of a world transformed, they grapple with the haunting question: what does survival really mean in a landscape stripped of civilization?

Each character brings a unique perspective on fear, hope, and the will to rebuild. The tension escalates as factions emerge, and trust becomes a rare commodity. What will they sacrifice to reclaim their humanity, and can they avoid repeating the mistakes that led to their downfall?

Hamilton masterfully weaves themes of redemption, resilience, and the human spirit’s unyielding quest for meaning amidst chaos. Packed with unexpected twists and philosophical depth, this audiobook invites listeners to ponder the fragile nature of existence and the bonds that unite us even in the darkest times. *City at World's End* is more than just a tale of survival; it's a profound exploration of what it means to start anew when the world as you know it has ended.

But as the stakes rise, so do the absurdities—will Jeeves manage to untangle the knots Bertram finds himself in, or will their plans spiral into chaos?

'My Man Jeeves' is packed with sharp dialogue, intricate plots, and a cast of unforgettable characters. Join Bertram and Jeeves on this laugh-out-loud journey that keeps you guessing and giggling until the very end. title: Pollyanna (A Journey of Joy and Resilience)

description:
When eleven-year-old Pollyanna arrives at her aunt's doorstep, she carries more than just her suitcase—she brings a radiant optimism that will challenge the gloom of her new home. Orphaned and sent to live with a stern aunt who views her as a burden, Pollyanna faces an uphill battle for acceptance. Yet, instead of succumbing to despair, she embraces her father’s unique 'glad game,' a perspective shift that encourages everyone around her to find joy in even the smallest moments.

As Pollyanna navigates the chilly reception from her aunt and the townspeople's skepticism, she becomes a beacon of hope. Her infectious spirit begins to unravel the tightly wound lives of those she encounters—from the grumpy neighbor to her aloof aunt—transforming their perspectives and forging unexpected friendships. Each chapter reveals new challenges and heartwarming connections that illustrate the power of positivity and resilience.

Listeners will be captivated by Pollyanna's heartfelt journey, filled with laughter, tears, and a relentless pursuit of happiness. Will her unwavering optimism spark change in the unforgiving town, or will she face insurmountable obstacles? Dive into this timeless tale of family, hope, and the magic of seeing the world through a lens of gratitude. Experience how one girl's determination to be glad can illuminate the lives of everyone around her.

title: Masters of Space (The Rise of a New Race)

In *Masters of Space*, Edward Everett Evans plunges you into a gripping struggle for survival against an ancient, unseen enemy that threatens to reclaim dominion over the cosmos. The story centers on a diverse group of young rebels, each with unique skills and motivations, who are determined to forge a new future. As they uncover long-buried secrets and face the daunting legacy of the Masters, their quest becomes a race against time. Can they unite their fractured worlds and stand strong against the shadows of the past?

Engage with themes of resilience, identity, and the fight for freedom as these characters navigate betrayal, alliances, and the haunting echoes of a brutal regime. title: Mr. Spaceship (Organic Warfare in Space)

description:
The moment humanity realizes the Yucks from Proxima Centauri are winning the war, desperation takes hold. Their mine belts, seemingly self-replicating, tighten around Terran planets like a noose, leaving Earth’s best minds scrambling for answers. How can they fight an enemy whose ships and weapons appear to be alive? Enter Mr. Spaceship, a revolutionary concept born from necessity. This audiobook dives into the journey of a team confronting an unprecedented challenge: if the Yucks can harness organic technology, why can’t humanity do the same?

As the narrative unfolds, listeners witness the struggle between innovation and survival, exploring themes of ethics in technology, the nature of life, and the lengths we go to in the name of victory. The story unfolds with gripping tension, revealing the transformative power of human ingenuity against an alien threat that seems one step ahead at every turn. Dick masterfully blends suspense and thought-provoking ideas, inviting listeners to ponder the future of humanity in the cosmos. Will they unlock the secret of the Yucks before it’s too late? Tune in to find out!

description:

As the son of a wealthy merchant, he grapples with the expectations of his family while yearning for freedom and excitement beyond the confines of his home. Through Marcus, listeners dive deep into the vibrant customs, intricate social structures, and rich traditions that shaped Roman life.

In "Our Little Roman Cousin of Long Ago," Julia Darrow Cowles invites you to experience the thrill of Roman childhood—where games of knucklebones and chariot races collide with the serious responsibilities of family and civic duty. As Marcus learns about loyalty, discipline, and the importance of community, he uncovers the mysteries of friendship and the complexities of growing up in a society that values honor above all.

This audiobook not only brings history to life but also explores timeless themes of identity, belonging, and the journey from childhood to maturity. Join Marcus as he faces challenges that will shape his understanding of courage and loyalty. Whether you're a history buff or simply curious about life in ancient Rome, this engaging tale will spark your imagination and enrich your knowledge of a fascinating past. Discover what it truly meant to be a child in the heart of an empire!

title: Think Like a Director: Escaping the Anechoic Hell Chamber
author: Maxmillian Michieli
description:
The great lie of the modern workplace is that your work gives you value. You actually believe that if you produce enough, you will matter. You treat work as if it bestows dignity upon you. 

This is a lie.

It’s the lie of the Anechoic Hell Chamber™, which is the isolation of your own heartbeat, set on repeat, and amplified. When you believe everything must be earned, you drown out a true, good, and beautiful existence. You place yourself first to the exclusion of communion and freedom. That’s what Hell is. You and only you.

Think Like a Director™ exists to set you free from the Hell you have been consuming.

I am giving away the Think Like a Director Field Manual for free: each of the first sixteen episodes is a chapter. I guess they call it a “podiobook.” I just call it your ticket to freedom. Have a listen. Then give it to your coworkers, your boss, your friends, whoever needs to hear it. Max

title: Love and Freindship (A Parody of Romance)
author: Jane Austen
description:
At just 14 years old, Jane Austen crafted a riotous tale of misguided romance and tangled friendships in "Love and Freindship." When the overdramatic Laura and the scheming Isabella embark on a journey filled with wild coincidences and ludicrous misunderstandings, their lives take unexpected turns. This juvenile story parodies the very romantic novels that Austen devoured as a child, turning the genre's tropes on their head.

As letters crisscross between characters, revealing their foibles and follies, listeners will delight in the sharp wit and keen observations that foreshadow Austen’s later masterpieces. The subtitle, "Deceived in Freindship and Betrayed in Love," hints at the chaos that ensues when loyalty is tested and affection is misdirected.

Expect a humorous exploration of love’s complexities, where friendship falters under the strain of romantic aspirations. With its playful tone and clever commentary, this audiobook invites listeners to reflect on the absurdities of love and the intricacies of human relationships. Prepare to laugh out loud and cringe at the characters' misadventures as you navigate the tangled web of emotions crafted by one of literature's greatest minds. Dive into this delightful parody and discover how Austen’s youthful creativity laid the groundwork for her enduring legacy.

https://www.goalsandgrace.co Hi, I’m Rev. Dr. Juliet Spencer Equipping people to succeed in business and in life is a vocation I love. That’s why I became a coach after spending years as a pastor. But I’ll be honest—it did not happen overnight. Not only that, but as much as I loved being a pastor, God placed in my heart a desire for the kind of financial freedom that leading a church wouldn't provide. My husband, Jimmy, and I have long talked about retiring in the mountains, taking care of my parents, and contributing to financially to ministries we love. title: English Steps to Fluency
author: Irineu de Oliveira Jnr
description:
Learn to speak English in full sentences, one question at a time.

English Steps to Fluency is an English speaking practice podcast for beginners and elementary learners (A1–A2). Practise listening to clear British English, build useful everyday vocabulary, and learn to answer questions with complete sentences. Whether you are starting from the basics or refreshing what you already know, each lesson gives you a clear opportunity to listen, think and speak aloud.

Knowing a word is a starting point. Using it in a sentence helps you communicate. This podcast brings vocabulary and speaking practice together through simple questions, model answers and repetition.

42 everyday topics. 420 questions and answers. One step at a time.

Step 1: Beginner covers familiar subjects, including the alphabet, numbers, days of the week, family, food, shopping, travel, feelings and comparisons. Each episode focuses on one topic and contains ten questions and answers, helping you practise language you can connect to everyday life.

Listen in order to work through the course, or revisit a topic whenever you need more practice. Pause before the answer, try a complete sentence yourself, and then compare it with the model. Return to the same episode and notice which answers become easier to say.

How to practise: Think • Answer • Learn

Follow this five-step speaking method:

  1. Listen to the question and say it aloud.
  2. Answer aloud in a full sentence.
  3. Listen carefully to the model answer.
  4. Repeat the correct sentence three times.
  5. Make it personal: change the answer to describe your own life.

Speak during the lesson, even when you are practising alone. Give yourself time to answer, repeat useful sentences, and build a regular practice habit.

English practice that fits your routine

Use the podcast for self-study, revision between English lessons, or practice with a teacher or study partner. Each topic offers a starting point for further conversation: answer the questions, change the details, and ask someone else the same questions.

Practise English listening, spoken English, everyday vocabulary and sentence patterns together. Focus on one topic at a time and move forward at a pace that lets you participate.

Continue learning with the book

This podcast accompanies English Steps to Fluency – Step 1: Beginner by Irineu de Oliveira Jnr, available on Amazon. Use the book’s photographs, questions and answers alongside the audio to connect what you see, hear and say. Search Amazon for the title and author to find the book.

Visit https://ukenglishonline.com for more English practice, audio and lessons.

Follow English Steps to Fluency to keep your next lesson within reach. If the podcast helps you practise, leave a review and share it with a friend who is learning English.

Start with Step 1: Beginner. Listen, answer aloud, and make each sentence your own.

Think • Answer • Learn.

description:
Welcome to County Arrest Records, your educational podcast for understanding public arrest records, county booking information, jail rosters, inmate lookup resources, and court records across the United States.
In each episode, we explore how county arrest records work, where to find publicly available information, and how to identify official sources for reliable research. Learn about arrest logs, booking reports, custody information, sheriff's office records, detention facilities, and public records access.
Our podcast covers county-specific arrest records and public information resources across Alabama and other states. We discuss topics such as searching arrest records by name, understanding jail rosters, locating official county resources, and distinguishing arrest records from criminal convictions and court case outcomes.
Whether you're researching your own public records, learning about county booking procedures, or looking for information about a particular jurisdiction, County Arrest Records provides straightforward explanations to help you understand the process.
Explore episodes covering local topics, including Coffee County Alabama Arrest Records, Clarke County Alabama Arrest Records, and Chambers County Alabama Arrest Records.
We also explain why verifying records matters, how public information can become outdated, and why official sources should be consulted before relying on important details.
Our mission is to make public records information easier to understand while encouraging accurate, responsible research. An arrest does not establish guilt, and charges or case outcomes may change. Always verify important information with the appropriate official agency. Everyone is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.
Follow County Arrest Records for educational discussions about county arrest records, booking information, inmate searches, jail rosters, and public records resources throughout America.

title: Episode 26.84 - GSM Minorities
author: Dr. Diana Sorrentino, Ph.D.
description:
Today’s Podcast:
Paradoxes of Gender Episode 26.84
Exploring the Issues & Challenges Facing Gender & Sexual Minority Individuals.  

Episode 26.85 
Guest:  Dr. Christine Hartigan, Psy.D., CAADC  

Paradoxes of Gender Podcasts:
The Paradoxes of Gender Podcasts are Designed to Deliver Professional Development Educational Programs for the LGBTQ+ Medical & Behavioral Healthcare Providers who provide Medical & Behavioral Healthcare Services to Transgender, Gender Diverse, Gender Non-Conforming, Gender Incongruent and Non-Binary Individuals.  

Prepared & Presented by:
Dr. Diana Sorrentino, Ph.D. Social-Psychologist & Behavioral Analyst  

Delivering comprehensive Medical or Behavioral Healthcare Services as a component of your practice on behalf of Transgender (TG), Gender Diverse (GD) Individuals and members of the LGBTQ+ Community may at times prove to be a little challenging. The challenges you may experience have historically been caused by a lack of specialized medical or behavioral health training you received in preparation for your career and the care you will be providing for Transgender and Gender Diverse patients.   

This understanding was underscored and reinforced by a 2011 study, reported in the Journal of the American Medical Association, the medical schools, on average, only provide Five (5) hours of academic or clinical instruction on LGBTQ+ healthcare requirements.  In the absence of specialized training; time is required to acquire first-hand real-world knowledge and experience with the diverse challenges, needs and experiences these individuals present and what they are confronted with as they live their lives in their Self-Attributed Non-Conforming Gender roles.  

Transgender, Gender Diverse, Gender Non-Conforming, Gender Incongruent & Non-Binary individuals, their families, friends, schools, employers and social-networks will also benefit from the content of these Podcasts in-spite of the fact that the detailed medical and psychological content of these programs focuses on the continuing educational needs and requirements of the medical or behavioral healthcare professional.  Knowledge is essential to counteract the negative publicity and the political hyperbole disseminated by individuals with no understanding of the history and underlying biological factors influencing gender non-conformity.    

Dr. Sorrentino is a Member of:
the World Professional Association for Transgender Health

We are joined by two content creators, Ivon a proponent of assistive technology and AI as a best friend and psychologist and Yoselin, a critic of excessive screen use and an advocate for traditional mental health approaches.

Is AI our greatest ally or an emotional trap? Which side are you on?

The Doggopedia Show is dedicated to documenting humanity’s oldest partnership.

For thousands of years, dogs have hunted with us, guarded our homes and livestock, fought beside us, moved our animals, shared our streets, and eventually found their way onto our couches. Their story is inseparable from ours.


Hosted by Jeff Greene, founder of The Doggopedia, the show explores that relationship through long-form conversations with the people who have dedicated their lives to understanding dogs—trainers, handlers, breeders, scientists, historians, rescuers, working-dog professionals, and others whose lives and work offer a deeper understanding of the animals beside us.


We explore genetics, behavior, training, breed history, working purpose, breeding, rescue, welfare, and the changing role of dogs in modern society. But these conversations are also about people: the cultures, industries, traditions, and ideas that have shaped our relationship with dogs across generations.


Some episodes challenge what we think we know. Others preserve knowledge and stories that deserve to be remembered. Together, they help tell the larger story of how two species built one of the most enduring partnerships in human history.


This is The Doggopedia Show. Documenting humanity’s oldest partnership.

Their combined experience has allowed them to develop market-leading perspectives on the common pitfalls and opportunities that businesses face, and they share this wisdom with listeners on every episode.Beyond their impressive credentials, Gruder and Tuzinkewich imbue the Boosting Business Value podcast with humor, warmth, and authenticity, making each episode feel like a conversation with trusted mentors who understand what it takes to succeed in business. This approach helps to make the podcast accessible to a broad range of listeners, from first-time entrepreneurs to seasoned business owners and executives, as well as business purchasers and trusted advisors.Listeners can expect to learn a great deal from the Boosting Business Value podcast. Each episode is packed with practical perspectives and actionable steps on a stunningly broad range of challenges that can be applied to a wide range of businesses, regardless of their industry or size. This makes the Boosting Business Value podcast a one-stop-shop for anyone seeking to create successful value acceleration and a profitable exit for their business.One of the best things about the Boosting Business Value podcast is the depth of resources available to listeners. In addition to the podcast itself, listeners can access a range of valuable resources through the Blue Sky Business Resources website, including free assessment tools and a variety of resources to assist through the full business lifecycle. These resources complement the podcast's advice, offering listeners a more in-depth understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing their business.For entrepreneurs and business owners looking to create value acceleration and a successful exit strategy, the Boosting Business Value podcast is a must-listen. With Dr. David Gruder and Jason Tuzinkewich at the helm, listeners can expect to gain the knowledge, skills, and resources they need to succeed in any industry. From mitigating risks to increasing operational efficiency to dealing with psychological factors in business, Gruder and Tuzinkewich offer an unmatched level of expertise and insight. Each episode, we’ll dissect a few chapters of a book at a time with unfiltered commentary and the personal stories that shape our perspective, like the girl group out to brunch you listen to from across the restaurant.

description:
Virtue & Vibes is the podcast where faith meets real life—unfiltered conversations, Kingdom wisdom, and a whole lot of laughs. Hosted by Rhonda Carden, Dimitri Collins, MeLaNie Dash, and Selene Rearden this space is for women who love God, value truth, and still enjoy good vibes.
Each episode tackles hot topics through a biblical lens such identity in Christ, modern dating, and navigating culture without compromising your convictions. If you’re a woman growing in faith, reclaiming your worth, and learning how to live set apart and joy-filled, you’re in the right place.

description:
Who decided this was food—and who’s making money from it?


Fork the System is a food podcast with an appetite for uncomfortable questions. Join Unapologetically Anna as she digs into food history, corporate marketing, health, disability, and the policies shaping what ends up on our plates.


Come for the surprising stories and sharp humor. Stay because you’ll never look at the grocery aisle quite the same way again. Fork it, let’s eat!

author: Scott Douglas
description: Ever feel like you're living on processed Jesus? A little Sunday school, a little movie, a few bumper stickers, and not much that actually feeds you. Organic Jesus is a short, casual show about faith, the Bible, and the questions we usually skip. Each episode takes one thing we think we know, strips off the additives, and looks at what's actually there, with history, humor, and probably too many pop-culture references. Under 10 minutes. No preservatives.

title: fixated on the macabre podcast
author: Bee
description: Fixated on the macabre is a podcast where ADHD-fueled obsession collides with all things dark and unsettling. Whether it's the history of serial killers, the science of near-death experiences, conspiracy theories, or the creepiest urban legends from around the world, the host's relentless curiosity ensures no stone is left unturned. Expect deep dives, and unfiltered curiosity. Because when your brain latches on, it really latches on.

title: Beyond the Process room
author: Arpco Legacy Enterprises
description:

Rather than broad business theory or generic leadership advice, each episode takes on the questions owners and executives are actually dealing with—from people and process to operations, leadership, growth, financial pressure, and major transitions.
Drawing from real experience building and operating businesses, the conversations go beyond the obvious symptoms to explore what may actually be driving the problem, what leaders should be asking, and what the right next step could look

description: A smart, unfiltered podcast that goes past the headlines to uncover the deeper truths shaping our world. Through sharp analysis, historical context, satirical takes, and unfiltered opinions, host Alexa Leighton connects the dots so you can see the bigger picture. No agendas. No fluff. Just the truth beyond the spin.

title: Better Than That: Beyond the Facade
author: BTT Beyond Facade
description: Trauma may shape our stories, but it doesn't have to define our future. This is a place for honest conversations about overcoming life's challenges, healing from trauma, & finding strength through growth. No matter where the pain stems from: religion, race, gender, physical or emotional abuse, mental health, or other life experience, we'll explore how people move forward with resilience, hope, & purpose. All are welcome. We value diverse experiences, perspectives, & respectful conversation. Healthy discussion helps us learn & grow. Personal attacks, harassment, hate, or disrespect toward our guests, listeners, or topics will not be tolerated. Content that harms the community will be removed, and repeat offenders will be blocked. If you're looking for authentic conversations, encouragement, and a community that believes healing and growth are possible, you're in the right place. Join us as we turn life's hardest experiences into opportunities for connection, resilience, and hope.

The Endless Mountain Derelicts are a Finger Lakes, NY band playing mountain rock and alt-country with a healthy dose of rowdy.

title: The Vintage Passport
author: Noah Tetzner
description:
The Vintage Passport is a weekly wine podcast hosted by historian and wine collector Noah Tetzner. Each episode explores the history and culture behind the world’s great wines through conversations with leading wine historians, authors, and scientists.  
Travel from the vineyards of Burgundy, Bordeaux, and Champagne to California, Italy, Australia, and across the world. Step into the cellars where French winemakers hid their treasures from the Nazis during World War II, and go back thousands of years to the search for where grapevines were first domesticated. Discover how wars, revolutions, trade, religion, and science shaped the wines we drink today, and why every bottle carries a story worth telling.  
Whether you’re a curious wine lover, a history buff, a sommelier, or someone who simply enjoys a good glass with a good story, The Vintage Passport is your guide to the history of wine, famous wine regions, grape varieties, and the people who made them matter.  
New episodes every week. Pour a glass, press play, and follow The Vintage Passport wherever you listen to podcasts.
Connect with the host: noah@profitwithpodcasting.com

title: After We Pray.

description: What happens after we pray? We wait, we question, we act, we trust. Faith comes into play when we pray and believe God for the things that we cannot see. Together we will talk about the tests, the testimonies and the seasons of silence after we pray because the story doesn't end with amen.

If you prefer storytelling grounded in documented facts and narrative depth, subscribe to The Vanished and hear the stories of the lost.

title: History of Economic Species
author: Ken Earon
description:
Every science has a mirror. Step in front of economics' and you'll see a very particular kind of human staring back.

Who is he? Where did he come from? And what does the way economists see us tell us about the world we live in?

History of Economic Species is a narrative documentary podcast about the economic image of the human being — how it was invented, how it has changed, and why it matters.

Over two centuries, economists have understood human behaviour in radically different ways. Each version of the economic man — Homo Economicus — was shaped by the politics, science, and ideological conflicts of its time. And with each version, the policies governing our lives changed too.

This podcast tells that story. Not as a textbook. As a journey through the personalities, rivalries, and intellectual battles that built the discipline whose assumptions we all live inside today.

Hosted by Ken Earon — educator, independent scholar, and PhD in the history and philosophy of science — History of Economic Species brings the history of economic thought to anyone who has ever wondered: do economists understand people? And if not, what are the consequences?

description: You watched the PBA Tour on Sunday. Now let’s unpack what you saw and heard. The Pin Deck is a companion to the PBA telecast that helps you understand the strategy behind professional bowling — lane conditions, oil patterns, ball motion, equipment, scoring and the decisions pros make under pressure. Host Allen Forkner puts the moments and concepts from each tournament into context, because the more you understand what’s happening between the foul line and the pins, the more fun bowling is to watch. Every shot has a story.

title: Scary Postpartum Thoughts with Arielle Wozniak
author: Arielle
description:
What if I hurt my baby? What if I lose control? Why am I having these horrible thoughts when I love my baby so much?


If scary, unwanted thoughts have left you questioning yourself, your faith, or your ability to be a good mom, this podcast is for you.


Scary Postpartum Thoughts with Arielle Wozniak is a faith-centered podcast for moms struggling with postpartum OCD, intrusive thoughts, and the fear that something is terribly wrong with them.

Arielle, founder of Peace After Postpartum, shares her lived experience with postpartum OCD, honest conversations about the thoughts women are often afraid to say out loud, and practical insights into the patterns that can keep OCD going, including reassurance-seeking, checking, avoidance, and mental compulsions.


Through short, relatable episodes, you'll explore what postpartum OCD can look like, how it intersects with motherhood and Christian faith, and what it means to move toward peace without needing absolute certainty.


You don't have to keep navigating scary postpartum thoughts in silence.


New episodes twice a week.


Learn more and find support through Peace After Postpartum.


This podcast offers education and lived-experience support, not diagnosis or a substitute for professional mental health treatment.
